boundaryGate.question: After accepting Alembic commit a5f8ff4d900b16abe5041c0d04b08e3f9db1ba7b, does the real P4 panorama gate pass: AlembicWorkspace dashboard four panorama tabs post-load show only workspace member data with no BiliDili leakage, BiliDili's own dashboard remains scoped to BiliDili, and the scoped rescan/provider terminal proof remains green?
boundaryGate.objectBoundary: Real local AlembicWorkspace project space ecf32806 and real BiliDili project 02a25032 only. This is Test execution/observation, not product implementation or controller acceptance.
controllerSelfChecks: Controller accepted Alembic source repair a5f8ff4d900b16abe5041c0d04b08e3f9db1ba7b after reviewing diff/callers/tests and rerunning focused vitest 14/14.

Previous blocker was reproduced from Test raw evidence and controller probes: AW /modules/dep-graph leaked BiliDili nodes and /projects selected BiliDili while /daemon/health and panorama APIs were AW scoped.
Alembic target reports build/check/lint/guard pass and dist probes clean for AW ProjectScope member graph and selectedProject binding; controller did not treat that as final P4 runtime proof.
realScenarioConditions: Use the true AlembicWorkspace dashboard/runtime, ensuring the Alembic daemon/runtime is rebuilt/restarted or otherwise demonstrably running code from commit a5f8ff4d900b16abe5041c0d04b08e3f9db1ba7b or later on main.
Open AlembicWorkspace panorama from a fresh browser context or proven clean storage context; wait for overview, dependencies, graph, and gaps tabs to finish loading.

Capture raw AW API evidence for /api/v1/daemon/health, /api/v1/projects, /api/v1/project-scope/folders or equivalent scope endpoint, /api/v1/panorama, /api/v1/panorama/health, /api/v1/panorama/gaps, and /api/v1/modules/dep-graph?level=module.
Capture visible screenshots and DOM/text evidence for all four AW panorama tabs after load.
Capture BiliDili contrast dashboard/API evidence showing it remains scoped to BiliDili and does not leak AlembicWorkspace members.

Run or observe one scoped BiliDili rescan/provider terminal proof sufficient for the existing P4 gate: completed terminal status/proof and effective embedding provider local Qwen/Ollama rather than DeepSeek embedding fallback.
successMeans: AlembicWorkspace panorama overview/dependencies/graph/gaps tabs post-load show only workspace member data and no BiliDili entries in header/body/API payloads relevant to the dashboard.
AW /modules/dep-graph?level=module no longer returns BiliDili ids/labels on the AW daemon/runtime, and /projects no longer selects stale BiliDili for the AW dashboard.
BiliDili contrast remains scoped to BiliDili and does not regress.
BiliDili scoped rescan/provider terminal proof remains green, including effective local Qwen/Ollama embedding evidence when embedding is exercised.
failureMeans: Return blocked with exact failing tab/API/log/probe and owner attribution candidate; do not patch source.
If the daemon cannot be restarted onto the accepted commit, return blocked with restart/build evidence and the first failing command/log.
If AW is clean but BiliDili or rescan/provider regresses, return blocked with raw contrast evidence and likely owner.
cannotConclude: Cannot conclude P4 demand completion; only controller can accept final gate after raw evidence review.
Cannot conclude Dashboard source needs changes unless API/backend probes are clean and UI still leaks in a fresh context.
Cannot conclude BiliDili is regressed from parent path substrings alone; compare actual projectRoot/dataRoot/member/module payloads.
stopConditions: Any forbidden operation would be required.
Required real project/runtime access is unavailable.
The test cannot establish that the daemon/runtime is running the accepted repair commit.
A reproducible P4 gate failure is found; stop and return blocked with raw evidence.

evidenceRequired: runtime commit/build/restart proof for Alembic commit a5f8ff4d900b16abe5041c0d04b08e3f9db1ba7b or later
AW four-tab screenshots plus DOM/text evidence after load
rescan/provider terminal proof logs or job/status JSON
allowedOperations: Restart/rebuild Alembic/AlembicWorkspace and BiliDili daemons as needed to run the accepted local main commits.
Use curl/API probes, browser screenshots/DOM capture, daemon/job logs, and SQLite read-only inspection where needed for evidence.
Use the real local BiliDili test workspace as authorized by the demand; rebuild runtime state through normal product flows if required by prior P4 test protocol.
forbiddenOperations: Do not edit product source code, test code, provider config, user secrets, or requirement documents.
Do not delete data roots, preclean the evidence away, or use a sandbox substitute for the required real BiliDili/AlembicWorkspace subjects.
Do not push, tag, release, bump versions, or mark controller acceptance.
Do not relax P4 gates or conclude success from API-only evidence if the UI still leaks BiliDili.
